name: Neem salad
summary: Gỏi sầu đâu is a salad of wild sầu đâu shoots and leaves, bitter, then sweet and cool, tossed with dried cá sặc, dried cá lóc, or meat and shrimp. A dressing of mắm me, sugar, garlic, and chili pulls bitter, sour, salty, and sweet into one bite.
origin: Châu Đốc and the wider An Giang plain.
taste: Bitter, sour, salty, and sweet together: tamarind, the bitter-then-sweet leaf, and chili.
howToEat: The leaves are mixed with dried cá sặc, dried cá lóc, or meat and shrimp. Many people blanch them first to soften the bitterness.
The dressing is mắm me, sugar, garlic, and minced chili.
seoTitle: Goi sau dau in Chau Doc
seoDescription: Gỏi sầu đâu is the bitter-then-sweet neem-leaf salad of Châu Đốc, with dried fish or shrimp and a tamarind mắm dressing.
